correctness.rationale: Pieri V_(n,0)⊗V_(n,0)=⊕_(j=0)^n V_(2n−2j,j) without multiplicity gives ∫|χ_n|⁴=n+1. The SU(3) center forces ∫χ_n³ conjugate χ_n and ∫χ_n⁴ to vanish unless 3|n; horizontal-strip interlacing gives multiplicity one for each when 3|n. Expansion yields (n+1)(S²+2|ab|²)+δ_n[4S Re(a conjugate b)+2Re(a² conjugate(b)²)]. With r=|ab|/S≤1/2 and x=cos arg(a conjugate b), optimization of Q=(n+1)+2n r²+4r²x²+4rx proves exact lower/upper bounds and all equality phases. Independently implemented Weyl integration as a Laurent constant term for n=1..7 and obtained moments (1,n+1,δ_n,δ_n); finite checks corroborate the all-n Pieri proof.
